Shrine Office</ref>. {{nihongo|'''Hachiman Shrine (Koura, Minamiizu)'''|八幡神社 (南伊豆町子浦)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is located in the western part of Minamiizu, northwest of the K?ura district, just south of the former Mihama Elementary School.

Its founding is unknown, but it is a candidate shrine for the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} "Iwakurawake-no-Mikoto Shrine" (??????????????), and an ancient shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no kuni jinjaich?|ja|伊豆国神階帳|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "J?shi-i no J? Ihakurawake no My?jin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/hatiman3_title.htm Hachiman Shrine] - Genmatsushi</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140128-03.html Hachiman Shrine] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.
